  • 3. Switch on when you land. In your phone settings, select the eSIM line for mobile data and turn on data roaming for that line. You are online.

sections.html: Most eSIM phones are dual SIM. WhatsApp stays linked to your usual number, so family groups and contacts carry on as normal while the eSIM handles the data.

If you run low, you can buy another plan on yrh.ai and install it the same way.
